purpose: Test whether R3 ordered-machine candidates survive a stricter source-grounded order gate instead of inheriting order from tied textual anchors or deterministic tie-breaking.
target_scope: PALOMAR/MUSIC/GENESIS R3 target constellation only for the first R3.1 run; no candidate receives a score bonus.

control_design.positive: The frozen candidate operator order is evaluated against source files whose SHA-256 must equal the R3 provenance SHA-256.
control_design.negative: Every alternate permutation of the same operator set is evaluated on the same source supports. A candidate does not pass if an alternate ordering ties or exceeds its strict-lineage support in any domain.
control_design.tie_policy: Any equal earliest operator positions are ORDER_UNRESOLVED and do not count as strict-order support.
control_design.anchor_policy: The earliest matching signal token for each operator must be distinct within a supporting document; shared earliest anchors do not count as an ordered witness.

claim_ceiling: A PASS establishes discriminating source-grounded textual operator order within the frozen corpus supports. It does not by itself prove temporal, causal, or physical mechanism identity across domains.
falsifier: The candidate order lacks two independent strict-order lineages in any domain, shares tied/identical anchors, source SHA has drifted, or an alternate permutation matches/exceeds its support.
seal: UNTIE THE STARS BEFORE CALLING THEM A CONSTELLATION.
